title: Field-aware invert of a prior leave-gap MoveClip command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip leave-gap MoveClip of a right remnant restores only that command's move write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert restores the remnant's start and the followed stay cue and keeps the later markers and unmoved earlier cues. A later text edit of the followed stay cue, or of the uninvolved left cue, also does not conflict; invert keeps the new text.

A later second leave-gap move of the same remnant, a later leave-gap out-trim of the remaining left remnant that remints the vacated gap filler, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered RippleDeleteClips, RippleTrimClip, leave-gap TrimClip, leave-gap DeleteClip, MoveClip / MoveClips, SplitClip, ExtractAudioClip, UnlinkAudioVideo / LinkAudioVideo, SetAudioTrackState, and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and does not silently take an unlinked audio partner or expand into a group move. Auto-close of the vacated source gap is still not a MoveClips mode.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds left and right cues, leave-gap moves the right remnant by 1s with the single-clip Move button, adds a later marker, inverts the MoveClip command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Extract is not required for this path. Official later work is a marker or a text edit, not a later left trim.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, leave-gap delete, move, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip / rightmost RippleDeleteClips / leave-gap DeleteClip, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
